task.title: 诊断: Troubleshoot database and storage issues
task.shortdesc: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Diagnose local SQLite, storage path, backup, and profile visibility issues without editing database rows directly.

prereq.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Use this procedure when profiles disappear, writes fail, migration evidence is unclear, backup checksums do not match, or BPM_DATABASE_URL points to an unexpected location.

context.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Current source deployment uses local storage such as sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/bpm.db and repository-owned files under data/, schema cache paths, and documentation site paths. There is no managed backup or restore orchestration in BPM 0.9.0.

step.cmd: 诊断 1: Confirm the active database URL and working directory.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Record BPM_DATABASE_URL, current directory, source revision, and whether the process runs from Linux filesystem or /mnt/c. Do not assume two shells point at the same data/bpm.db.

step.cmd: 诊断 2: Check migration and profile API evidence before opening storage files.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Focused rerun: alembic upgrade head, then curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/profiles?limit=50. If the API returns expected profiles, the symptom may be filter, lifecycle, or browser state.

step.cmd: 诊断 3: Verify backup evidence before destructive recovery.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Check mkdir -p backups, cp data/bpm.db backups/bpm-pre-update.db, and sha256sum backups/bpm-pre-update.db records. Keep exports of critical policies.json profiles as separate evidence.

step.cmd: 诊断 4: Avoid direct database row edits.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Do not edit SQLite rows, generated artifacts, or schema cache files as routine recovery. Use documented profile archive, restore, import, export, or update-from-source procedures instead.

step.cmd: 诊断 5: Escalate with storage evidence when recovery is unsafe.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Include database URL, file path, checksum, migration command, API response, and backup/export evidence.
info.note: If no verified pre-failure backup exists, stop before deleting or replacing data/bpm.db; BPM does not provide point-in-time recovery.

result.p: 操作员获得分类诊断，保护 user data，并知道下一个 smallest rerun。 The operator has a storage diagnosis that preserves user data and separates database state from UI or filter symptoms.

postreq.p: 修复后返回相关 Administrator/DevOps workflow，只重跑受影响的 checks。 After storage is stable, rerun health/readiness and the smallest affected API workflow.
